text: Everywhere: 1-5 Tab Shift-Tab switch section · +/- refresh interval · W save configuration
q F10 Ctrl-C quit · Mouse click tabs, rows, headers; wheel scrolls
Up Down PgUp PgDn select · F6 < > sort · i inver
n switch network interface · d switch GPU
d switch GPU · F6 sort · / filter · F9 signal
Space fold branch · F5 list/tree · ← → tabs · [ ] scroll
F7 F8 nice -1/+1 (main thread only, like htop)
al: Up/Down choose, Space subtree, Enter send
i interface · c TCP/UDP · l LISTEN · F6 sort · z reset · Enter go to process
F9 signal to the connection's process
/ search · f filter · u system/user · s t r start/stop/restart · e enable/disable
